goal: Reproduce and repair a fresh unfamiliar open mypy bug without a pre-encoded Project Brain solution, then verify the fix against relevant regression coverage.
observed_failure: A four-case match over tuple[bool, bool] was incorrectly reported as non-exhaustive and caused a missing-return error.
causal_diagnosis: Fixed-tuple sequence negative narrowing only preserved complements when zero or one subpattern was conditional. Multi-conditional tuple patterns discarded the complement and left the original tuple type.
repair: Represent the complement as a linear union partitioned by the first subpattern that fails. This produces exact negative narrowing without exponential expansion.

verification.exact_issue_reproduction_after_fix: Success: no issues found in 1 source file
verification.existing_precision_change: testMatchSequencePatternNegativeNarrowing now reveals the exact remainder tuple[Literal[2], Literal['a'] | Literal['b']] | tuple[Literal[1], Literal['b']] instead of a broader superset; expectation updated.
